content: W3C Indexed Database API 3.0 规范第 2.4 节明确规定：A key has an associated type which is one of: number, date, string, binary, or array. The following ECMAScript types are valid keys: Number primitive values, except NaN; Date objects; String primitive values; ArrayBuffer objects; Array objects. Attempting to convert other ECMAScript values to a key will fail. Boolean 类型并非有效 key，不能直接建索引。
